crossRefs.note: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

translations.web: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
translations.bsb: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
translations.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
translations.asv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbor: love therefore is the fulfilment of the law.
